name: Book of Artisans: a new profession is not offered once the character has no free profession slot
contract: Trainer::GetSpellState marked the entry rank of every profession available even when the character had no free primary profession point, while Trainer::CanTeachSpell refused the purchase. The book filters its window to trainable rows, so a character with two professions (MaxPrimaryTradeSkill = 2) still saw every other Apprentice row in green and the window opened on them instead of the recipes it could learn. Expected: with no profession, Apprentice Engineer (4039) is available (0); after learning Alchemy (2259) and Tailoring (3908) it is not a row (-1), while Journeyman Tailor (3912) is still available.

steps.label: Control: with free slots Apprentice Engineer is available
Control: Journeyman Tailor is still available
DISCRIMINATING: with both slots used Apprentice Engineer is not a row
